raw_segments.text: "'You getty in,' he added, motioning to me with his tomahawk and throwing the clothes
to one side. He really did this in not only a civil but a really kind and charitable way.
I stood looking at him a moment. For all his tattooings he was on the whole a clean, comely
looking cannibal. What's all this fuss I have been making about, thought I to myself?
The man's a human being just as I am. He has just as much reason to fear me as I have
to be afraid of him. Better sleep with a sober cannibal than a drunken Christian.'"
